args_schema.description: Config accepted by both trigger types, and the args of both observable functions (`args_format`).

metadata.description: Equality match against the record's `session_metadata` (every key given here must equal the stored value — subset match).

session_id.description: Only deliver events for this session.

args_schema.title: BindingConfig

description: Fires when a function call is held for human approval and its inbox record is written. Observe it with args { session_id?, metadata? } (the approval::pending-created binding config); every matching observer receives PendingApprovalRecord & { status: "pending" }. Only the approval-gate worker fires it: invoking it directly is refused.

AccessRequest.description: The filesystem access ask parsed from the shell/coder `filesystem_access_request` tail. Only present on `kind: "filesystem_access"` records.

attempted_path.description: The raw offending path from the request, as sent by the caller.

error_code.description: The jail-scope rejection code that produced this hint (`S215`, `S220`, `C215`, `C220`).

requested_root.description: Canonical root a grant should target (existing directory, or nearest existing ancestor directory of the offending path).

oneOf.description: A function call held by `approval::gate` (the normal case).

A function call held by `approval::filesystem-access-watch` after a jail-scope rejection carrying a `filesystem_access_request` — the console should ask "allow access to `requested_root`?" instead of a generic approve/deny prompt.

event_schema.description: The inbox payload — shared by both triggers, `list_pending`, and `get_pending`. Self-describing (all ids inside the value) and notification-safe (arguments pass through redaction).

arguments_excerpt.description: Redacted — safe to forward to notification channels.

assistant_excerpt.description: First text block of the assistant message that contained this function_call. Best-effort; not derivable from `pre_trigger` `HookInput` in v1, so always omitted today.

event_schema.title: PendingApprovalRecord
